title: 2-Min High-Protein Fudge Mug Brownie
hookLine: 22g protein molten chocolate brownie in a mug with zero refined sugar, zero flour, and 60s cook time.

items.name: Chocolate whey or plant protein powder + 1 tbsp cocoa
Unsweetened almond milk + 1/4 tsp baking powder

steps.title: Grease Mug & Measure Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Lightly coat a wide, microwave-safe mug or ramekin with a thin swipe of oil or butter so the cake releases cleanly. Measure {pm_prot} and {pm_ban} right into the mug and whisk with a fork until completely smooth.

steps.title: Whisk in Mug & Microwave 55 Seconds
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {pm_prot}, {pm_ban}, and {pm_mlk} smooth in a mug, press {pm_chp} into the center, and microwave 50–55 seconds for a molten lava middle.
steps.creatorSecret: Never microwave past 60 seconds—pulling early keeps the center fudgy instead of dry.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {pm_mlk} and {pm_chp} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Rest 1 Minute & Add Toppings
steps.instructionTemplate: Let the mug rest 60 seconds after microwaving so the steam settles and the center finishes setting into a tender, spoonable crumb. Top with {pm_mlk} and {pm_chp} and enjoy warm right from the mug.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 210 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
